conviction_note: Eastnine already published the forward lines on 25 Sep: earnings capacity per share 0.28 EUR at closing (down 9%), LTV 55% (59% with the VAT loan) and NAV per share unchanged at 5.12 EUR. What is still unknown is Q3 profit from property management (largely implied by the Q2 earnings capacity) and the Q3 valuation and derivative lines. Those lines face a 2-year EUR swap rate that rose about 60bp after July, and the rise cuts both ways. So abs_move is near the pre-released base, scaled to 3.5% for thin turnover and this name's 2.5-5% report-day history, p_up is 48, and the scaled number (-0.14) is smaller than the findings sum (-0.3) because the valuation finding's sign is genuinely uncertain.

already_public.what: Pro forma earnings capacity including The Bridge at closing: profit from property management per share 0.28 EUR (0.31 at Q2, -9%), rising to 0.36 EUR (+18%) once all signed tenants have moved in by Q4 2027. Interest-bearing debt 492 -> 706 MEUR. LTV 45% -> 55% (59% including a temporary VAT loan, to be repaid within the coming quarter). Economic occupancy 96% -> 88%. Long-term NAV per share unchanged at 5.12 EUR. Average interest rate 4.5%.

Bridge completion: underlying property value 285 MEUR (300 in July), purchase price 240 MEUR (preliminary 260), of which 20 MEUR is conditional. Financed with existing cash, a 180 MEUR five-year Erste loan and 34 MEUR of refinancing. No new shares issued.

Q2 2026 earnings capacity: profit from property management 30,103 TEUR a year, 0.31 EUR per share, after the Riga divestment (completed 2026-05-25). The Riga office closes with effect from Q3. Dividend fixed by the AGM at SEK 0.32 per quarter.
Release time: the report will be published 22 Oct at 14:00 CET (during the session), with the webcast at 15:00.

new_in_release.expect: Q3 profit from property management of about 7.0-7.4 MEUR, against a record 8,222 TEUR in Q3 2025. Expect a year-on-year decline headline, already implied by the Q2 earnings capacity (about 7.5 MEUR a quarter), the Riga sale and the cost of closing the Riga office. Slightly negative, mostly known.

Unrealised property value changes at 30 Sep, the first valuation of The Bridge, and transaction costs on an asset deal. With rates rising, property values lean negative. Unknown sign, the main source of surprise.
Derivative value changes: positive, given the higher EUR swap rates in Q3. They sit below profit from property management and the market looks through them.
Updated earnings capacity at 30 Sep. Expected near the pre-released 0.28 EUR, possibly a touch lower if the floating-rate share was repriced. No formal guide exists.
Unchanged at SEK 0.32 a quarter, set by the AGM.
NAV per share in SEK mechanically about 2% higher, because EUR/SEK went from 11.08 to 11.34 over the quarter.

bar: Unsourced. Yahoo carries one analyst's EPS estimate, and it missed by 24-36% on the last two quarters, so it is not a usable bar. No Modular Finance or Infront consensus was found in the Finwire coverage. The working bar is the company's own Q2 earnings capacity (30,103 TEUR a year, https://attachment.news.eu.nasdaq.com/ae3cee2689184adfbcf21ef302a7fb8f1) plus the 25 Sep pro forma (https://view.news.eu.nasdaq.com/view?id=bbda62cad4d6b285753d9b3bdb98a1c57&lang=sv&src=listed). Every finding is capped small.
session_check: bmo: the window is close(2026-10-21) -> close(2026-10-22), NOT the sealed amc window. The issuer's own invitation (Nasdaq Nordic, 2026-10-15) says the report is published 22 October at 14:00 CET, inside the Stockholm session (09:00-17:30), with the webcast at 15:00 CET. Sweden is still on CEST until 25 Oct; the Q2 release was stamped '14.00 CEST'. The sealed amc window, close(10-22) -> close(10-23), would miss the 14:00-17:30 reaction on the event day. findings.finding: The 2-year EUR swap rate rose from about 2.8% to about 3.4% between the July Bridge announcement and mid-September (Placera, 2026-09-15). The Q3 report's property valuation line (including the first mark on The Bridge) faces yield pressure, partly offset by positive derivative revaluations.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q2 2026 had small positive unrealised property changes (+2.9 MEUR) and the day was dominated by the Bridge deal (+4.97%, then -3.40%). Q1 2026 fell 3.87% on report day, and Q4 2025 fell 2.53%. Line-level attribution is not available.
findings.original_quote: Sedan affären annonserades har till exempel den tvååriga swapräntan i euro stigit från ungefär 2,8% till 3,4%. ... Högre räntor kan visserligen sätta press på fastighetsvärdena (Since the deal was announced the two-year euro swap rate, for example, has risen from about 2.8% to 3.4% ... Higher rates may admittedly put pressure on property values)
findings.why_not_priced: Partly priced. The same article said property stocks 'har än så länge inte reagerat nämnvärt' (had not yet reacted noticeably), and since then EAST fell from SEK 45.55 (15 Sep) to 42.50 (-6.7%, 3m -7.4%). If the market expected a meaningful write-down, the NAV discount would already be well beyond the ~20% Placera cited. At 42.5 against a Q2 NAV of SEK 56.76 it is about 25%, which suggests some of it has been taken. Macro-to-company transmission is unconfirmed: Warsaw prime yields were 6.00% and stable at Q2 (CBRE).
findings.independence: CBRE Warsaw Q2 2026 office figures show the prime yield stable at 6.00%, which points the other way on valuations: https://mktgdocs.cbre.com/2299/45e8e6d5-1381-4971-b7a0-e1c759390bfa-1469974859/Warsaw_Q2_2026_Office_Figures.pdf

findings.finding: Q3 profit from property management will print well below the record Q3 2025 of 8,222 TEUR, at about 7.0-7.4 MEUR. The Q2 earnings capacity of 30,103 TEUR a year sets the run-rate after the Riga sale, and the Riga office closes from Q3, so the headline will be a year-on-year decline.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q2 2026 had the headline 'Eastnine minskar förvaltningsresultatet' (-7.6% y/y) and the stock rose on the day, but on the Bridge news. ABG called Q2 broadly in line.
findings.original_quote: Förvaltningsresultatet har minskat huvudsakligen på grund av försäljningen av fastigheter. (Profit from property management has decreased mainly due to the sale of properties.) Q3 2025 comparator: 'Förvaltningsresultatet ökade med 48 procent till 8 222 TEUR (5 545)' https://www.eastnine.com/sites/eastnine/files/pr/202510238435-2.pdf
findings.why_not_priced: Mostly priced. The decline lands inside the company's own disclosed earnings capacity, so it is sized near zero. It is filed because the Finwire headline will read as a fall against a record comparator, and on a thin name with one Yahoo analyst the headline can move the first minutes.
findings.independence: ABG 2026-07-14 on Inderes: 'earnings capacity contracted sequentially on the Riga divestments, as expected' https://www.inderes.se/en/third-party-research/eastnine-warsaw-to-become-the-largest-market-abg

findings.finding: EUR/SEK rose from 11.08 (30 Jun) to 11.34 (30 Sep 2026), so the long-term NAV per share reported in SEK (56.76 at Q2) will mechanically show about a 2% rise before value changes, and the Finwire table will report it.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: None measurable. Finwire's Q2 headline table reported 'Långsiktigt substansvärde, EPRA NAV, per aktie, SEK 56,76 55,05 3,1%'.
findings.why_not_priced: Mechanical and computable, and the SEK share price already reflects the EUR asset value, so it is near zero. It is filed only as a presentation effect on a headline NAV that a thin retail-heavy register (Nordnet and Avanza pension are owners 3 and 5) reads in SEK.
findings.independence: The Q2 report states NAV in SEK at '1 EUR = 11,09 SEK den 30 juni 2026' https://attachment.news.eu.nasdaq.com/ae3cee2689184adfbcf21ef302a7fb8f1

findings.finding: The first quarter-end valuation of The Bridge (bought as an asset deal at 240 MEUR, 20 MEUR of it conditional, against an underlying value of 285 MEUR cut from 300 in July) will run through Q3 unrealised value changes. Transaction costs on an asset deal are typically expensed there.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: No prior acquisition of this size reported in-window to compare.
findings.original_quote: Förvärvet skedde genom ett tillgångsförvärv. ... Köpeskillingen uppgick till 240 MEUR. Totalt 20 MEUR av köpeskillingen är villkorade (The acquisition was made as an asset acquisition ... The purchase price was 240 MEUR. A total of 20 MEUR of the purchase price is conditional)
findings.why_not_priced: The pro forma kept NAV per share at 5.12 EUR, so the company signalled no NAV effect from the deal. The sign of the first mark is inference. It is a one-off below profit from property management with no path to earnings capacity, so it is a fraction of the money.

baseline_tension: The findings are near-balanced and slightly negative, consistent with a small priced lean (+0.16, run-up driven) and a 20-day run-up of -3.2%. Nothing cuts sharply against either.
language_note: Placera's Swedish analysis (2026-09-15) carried the one quantified rate fact: the EUR 2-year swap rose from 2.8% to 3.4% after July. It also carried the CEO's statement ruling out a share issue at the NAV discount and the full owner table. Neither appeared in the English ABG or Inderes summaries.

Realtid's Swedish coverage (2026-09-25) set out the dilution path, earnings capacity per share 0.31 -> 0.28 before rising to 0.36, under the headline 'skulderna växer snabbt'. The English completion release states only the 18% end-state.
The FI insider register (Swedish only) carried Peter Elam Håkansson's August-September purchases.
The issuer's releases themselves are bilingual and identical in substance. The Swedish completion release's pro forma table matches the English one.
lessons_applied: 'A number the market has already been told is worth 0': the PPM year-on-year decline lands inside the Q2 earnings capacity and the 25 Sep pro forma, so it moved from -0.2 to -0.1.

Proxy and macro transmission ('a narrow proxy loses to a broad series'): the rates-to-valuation finding is macro-to-company and contradicted by stable Warsaw yields at Q2, so it moved from -0.5 to -0.4, applied once.

'Too small about the move' and 'understatement is systematic': abs_move_pct raised from 3.0 to 3.5. The quarter's P&L and valuation lines are new even though the forward lines are pre-released, turnover is thin and recent report days moved 2.5-5%. p_up held at 48 (pre-released forward lines, no guide change, so it stays within 45-55).
Session lesson (Adocia, Philogen, VIGO): session_check opens with the verdict 'bmo' and cites the issuer's own 14:00 timestamp, because the sealed amc window would miss the event-day reaction.
